g.text: Daily means are descriptive, not uncertainty intervals. Same fixed β=5.4; no refitting.
Raw SM3 is a sensor proxy with flagged source limits; trends do not prove a causal moisture effect.
Tower1 uses 30 Dec 00:00; Tower2 uses 30 Dec 03:00 at their shared period boundary.
